# Hoizr Business — Ticketing, marketing & ops for India's live nights

> Hoizr Business is the organizer-side product in the Hoizr family. Venues and event organizers can publish events directly and use direct ticketing, owned fan CRM, AI event evaluation, and built-in marketing and ops without a subscription wall. Built by Hoizr Technologies Pvt. Ltd. for clubs, festivals, comedy, and live music organisers.

## The Hoizr family
Operated by Hoizr Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

- **Hoizr** — Consumer ticketing surface. https://hoizr.com
- **Hoizr Business** — This site. Host tools. https://business.hoizr.com
- **Hoizr Artist** — Performing-artist profiles, fan CRM, merch. https://artist.hoizr.com
- **Hoizr Promoters** — Coming soon. Tools for tour promoters and agencies.

## Core values
- Owned audience, not rented. Hosts keep their own customer relationships and full data ownership.
- No gatekeeping. Event organizers can publish directly without a subscription wall or stripped-down starter tier.
- AI event evaluation. Hoizr studies the event and provides the best possible offer, including lowered commission where the event qualifies.
- India-first. UPI, GST invoices, Section 24 compliance, regional language support, host payouts in INR.

## Key surfaces

- [Home](https://business.hoizr.com/): Platform overview and primary CTAs.
- [Platform access](https://business.hoizr.com/pricing): Direct event publishing without a subscription wall.
- [How it works](https://business.hoizr.com/how-it-works): End-to-end host journey from onboarding to settlement.
- [Products](https://business.hoizr.com/product): Ticketing, fan CRM, scanner, marketing tools, AI offers, host payouts.
- [Blog](https://business.hoizr.com/blog): Stories on live entertainment, ticketing, and India's nightlife economy.
- [RSS](https://business.hoizr.com/rss.xml): Blog feed for crawlers, readers, and AI agents.
- [Sitemap](https://business.hoizr.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL inventory for public marketing pages.
- [Legal](https://business.hoizr.com/legal/terms): Terms, privacy, cookies, GST, and company disclosures.
- [Contact](https://business.hoizr.com/contact): Sales and support inbound.

## Audience
Event hosts, club owners, festival promoters, comedy producers, and venue operators across India.

## Counterpart
Customer-facing ticket buying lives at https://hoizr.com — that's where attendees discover events, book tickets, follow artists, and check in.
